# Where does DXC's existing out-of-bounds subscript check fire?
#
# Each case in case-positions.hlsl is compiled on its own with -D CASE=n against the
# ground-truth Debug build. Recorded per case: the exact command, the exit status, every
# error:/warning: line, and whether DXIL was emitted ("; shader hash:" present in stdout).
#
# Run by: python probe-positions.py   (writes this file)

# dxc: C:\prj\DirectXShaderCompiler\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe
# version: dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5433-ab540090)(1.9.0.5433) - 1.9.0.5433 (triage, ab5400907)

==============================================================================
CASE 1  uint x = indices[3];                       plain local initializer
# cmd: dxc -T cs_6_0 -E main -Od -D CASE=1 case-positions.hlsl
# exit: 0x80004005
# dxil emitted: no
case-positions.hlsl:17:20: error: vector element index '3' is out of bounds

==============================================================================
CASE 2  g_vertices[indices[3]].x                   index of a resource operator[]  (reporter's shape)
# cmd: dxc -T cs_6_0 -E main -Od -D CASE=2 case-positions.hlsl
# exit: 0x00000000
# dxil emitted: yes
<no error: or warning: line in stdout+stderr>

==============================================================================
